sources.note: Nothing on stress or accent anywhere (a full-text search for stress/accent found nothing). Noy appears only as 'Lɔɔ (lɔ́ɔ̄) (or Noy).. extinct' in the inventory (preprint p.2), as 'the then nearly extinct Lɔɔ (Palayer 1975b)' in the documentation outline (p.4), and in fn. 22 (p.11): 'Some of the 43 Lɔɔ words collected by Palayer (1975b) also contain the interior vowels [ə] and [ʉ]'.
